status: conditional descriptive fits, not a hardware calibration

method.input: Stereo mean, no EQ/normalization; harmonic fitting only removes constant and slope. Same12-harmonic least-squares method as moogie-harmonic-audit.
method.frequency_fit: Per note optimizef0 in38..39Hz to minimize whole-note residual over on+30ms..off-20ms.
method.windows: Default40ms centered at on+40,50,...ms, ending before off-35ms; fit each fourth PCM sample. Sensitivity widths30/60/80ms, common window shift+/-20ms and eachnote separately.
method.ratios: 20log10(A4/A2),20log10(A6/A2),20log10(A8/A2). Offset independently fitted pernote and harmonic ratio, absorbing static oscillator spectrum/captureEQ.
method.lp24_svf: At normalizedx=f/fc, gain_dB=-10log10((1-x²)²+4x²)-10log10((1-x²)²+1.44x²); this is the analog equivalent of currentSVF stagesk1=2,k2=1.2. Exact44.1kHzTPT prewarp changes magnitude<=0.006dB for75..320Hz andfc20..20000Hz.
method.butterworth: gain_dB=-10log10(1+(f/fc)^8), used only as sensitivity model.
method.fixed_physics: base102.831098Hz andpeak1157.018576Hz are current engine mappings for upper cutoff30,depth22, NOT manufacturer measurements. Currentdecay49tau8.306249ms; decaySeconds49=57.377536ms is the alternativetau hypothesis.
method.optimization: Least squares; nuisance offsets eliminated by pernote/ratio mean residual. Multiple seeds. Bounded-free fits usebase20..500Hz,peak600..20000Hz,time3ms..3s. Several solutions hit bounds, so those values are not estimates of physical endpoints.
method.uncertainty: Sensitivity ranges are deterministic perturbations, not statistical confidence intervals; windows overlap and residuals are correlated.

limitations: Even-harmonic isolation assumes symmetric lowerSquare/Triangle and a linear audio path; Roland English/Japanese descriptions inconsistently attribute even harmonics to triangle. Actual isolated hardwaretriangle spectrum is unverified.
The fixed offsets cancel only static responses. Nonlinear filter/recording stages and unknown controllers can invalidate the single-filter model.
At the same pulse note frequency, upperPULSE duty, fixedLOWFREQ shelf and staticEQ do not affect temporal ratios if they remainfixed; this is an assumption.

Long finalMoogie note14.85..15.30 retains a bright H8/H2~−10dB for~350ms unlike openingnotes, thenpitchbends. It cannot safely constrain unchanged-preset basecutoff. Distlongnotescontainpitchbends; Distupperoverdrive also regenerates harmonicsafterthefilter.
These data favor a longer-lived brightness envelope over current mapping, but do not establish a globaltimefactor, cutofflaw, resonanceQ or one unique decayfunction.
recommended_action: Keep conditional model fits separate from hardware calibration. A diagnostic candidate may use an explicitly interpolated empirical mapping while controlled capture remains outstanding.

heldout_test.base_and_peak_source: unchanged Septum mapping, not manufacturer measurements
heldout_test.qualification: Assumes symmetric lower square/triangle and linear processing. Only note0 fits timing and constant ratio offsets; notes1,2 are held out. No original MIDI, raw recording chain or isolated hardware waveforms. Overlapping frames are correlated; sensitivity ranges are not confidence intervals.
